evidence.detail: rs/c exposes exactly four static integer transforms and no state: two map local X/Y coordinates inside an 8x8 chunk under quarter-turn rotation, and two perform the same transform while accounting for object width/height.
All methods normalize rotation with '& 3' and return the expected quarter-turn coordinate forms using 7-coordinate and 7-coordinate-(size-1) complements.
R53 ObjectManager uses these transforms while decoding rotated map/object chunks so source-local coordinates and object footprints are remapped into the destination chunk consistently.

candidates.note: MapChunkRotation is a conservative semantic recovery name for this stateless 8x8 region/object coordinate rotation helper; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
